info.title: memorantado REST API
info.description: Local REST API used by the memorantado web UI and by agent clients (scoped recall, curation, file evidence). Invalid input answers 400 {error: "invalid_input"}; a change the target's state forbids answers 409 {error: "conflict"}; a missing target answers 404 {error: "not_found"}.
